# Krcmic.com

> > Freelance digital marketing and web services portfolio by Michal Krčmář, a Czech-based online marketing professional offering web design, development, UX, and digital strategy.

Krcmic.com is the professional portfolio of Michal Krčmář, based in Zlín, Czech Republic. The site combines core freelance services with an educational blog covering digital marketing, business metrics, gaming terminology, and technology trends.

- Digital Marketing
- Freelancer Portfolio
- Web Design & Development
- Business Metrics (CAC, Churn Rate, QoQ, YoY, CAGR, MoM)
- Financial Analysis

- AI & Hallucinations
- Affiliate Marketing
- Czech Republic
- Michal Krčmář
- VoIP & Communication Technology
- RNG (Random Number Generator)
- Project Management
- Social Media Marketing
